Commentary.Commentary: A total anti-climax to what has been happening in the first 3 ODIs. For the first time in this series, the Windies did not fire with the bat at all. They will be hoping to forget tonight's game and come out refreshed for the final ODI in Thiruvananthapuram, on Thursday, November 1, at 1330 local (0800 GMT). Do join us then. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Man of the Match Rohit Sharma says he has been practicing some slip catching for a while and it was good to hold on to some catches today at first slip. Adds further that it is a bit tricky to field in the slips, especially to Kuldeep, but he reckons that playing him in the nets has helped him in fielding in the slips. Mentions that it was a clinical performance while batting as after losing 2 quick wickets they played well to come up with a big, match-winning partnership which helped them put a big total on the board. Ends by saying that it is very heartening to see such kind of a performance from the bowlers.

The Indian skipper Virat Kohli says he is happy that they ticked all boxes in all three departments pretty well. Adds further that in the last game, the Windies put them under pressure and reckons that his team did really well today to bounce back with such a performance. Credits Ambati Rayudu for the way he batted at number four position. Ends by saying that the youngster Khaleel Ahmed is an exciting talent and if the pitch has something to offer, he can be a good force to reckon with.

The Windies captain Jason Holder admits that they did not play well enough today. Feels that they gave away too many runs in the first innings. Adds further that during their batting their batsmen did not apply themselves well in the middle and hence they lost early wickets which meant that they were behind in the game from the very beginning. Ends by saying that probably he may come higher up the order from the next game.

Sanjay Manjrekar on the ropes is seen interviewing the youngster, Khaleel Ahmed, who says that he had hoped that there will be some moisture in the wicket which will help him and that is exactly what he got. Informs that he is working on his bowling and practicing hard in the nets. Reckons that he has practiced well and today the execution of the plans was much better. Regarding the wicket of Samuels, he mentions that the batsman was expecting an inward shaping delivery but the ball went away taking the outside edge of Marlon's bat. Adds further that there is no harm in appealing when there is a chance of getting a wicket. Ends by saying that he will look to continue with such good performances in future as well.

Virat Kohli will be a pleased man tonight. His bowling and fielding were top notch when it mattered the most, but, it turned a bit clumsy towards the end. Khaleel Ahmed was in prime form, making the ball move both ways and nipped out three wickets. Kuldeep Yadav also claimed a 3-fer and altogether it was a team effort by the Men in Blue to go 2-1 up in the series.

Chasing a mammoth total, Windies lost wickets in clumps upfront. Bhuvneshwar Kumar struck early to get the initial breakthrough and that was followed by a couple of run outs, of which, one was of Shai Hope. The tourists were dented badly after that blow and never recovered. Shimron Hetmyer, another star of their batting line-up, flopped and that left them reeling. Jason Holder fought a lone battle, scoring a half century, but he only delayed the inevitable.

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, the Indian openers provided a strong platform. Rohit Sharma and Ambati Rayudu were involved in a double century partnership to pave the way for India's big score. Both the batters got their respective hundreds in the process and entertained the local Mumbai crowd with their delightful stroke play.

Commanding show by India to take an unassailable lead in the series! They were under the cosh after losing the last match but have roared back to register a resounding win. This is their third biggest victory over a team in terms of runs - BIGGEST OVER A TEST-PLAYING NATION. Everything went according to the plan for the home team in all the three departments and they went on to steamroll the resurgent Windies unit.

OUT! Timber is rattled. Beautiful googly this. Windies innings has been wrapped up on 153. Kuldeep flights this one up and lands this full around middle. The ball hits the deck and turns away from Roach who is looking to defend it. The ball goes past his outside edge and crashes into the off pole. A clinical performance by the Indian bowlers as they win by a huge margin, 224 runs to be exact.
A bit behind the full length on off, Holder goes back and turns it into the square leg region to pick up another run.
On a good length attacking the stumps, played into the mid-wicket region.
Jason has driven it through mid-off. One run added to the total.

Big appeal for LBW, given not out. Keeps this on the leg stump line, may be a bit outside leg. Holder misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. Khaleel appeals loud but the umpire rightfully negates it as it had pitched outside the line of the leg pole.
Full and straight on off, driven back to mid off.
Lands this on a good length around off and angling further away from the right-hander. Roach looks to drive on the up but is beaten as he plays inside the line of that delivery.
Shortish ball around off, punches by Roach off the back foot through the cover region for a single.
Leg bye. On his pads. Roach goes for the flick but the ball hits the batsman low on the pads. A strong appeal from the bowler and fielders. Going down leg. A leg bye added to the total.
Flighted ball around off, Kemar is beaten as he misses the line of the delivery.
Appeal for an LBW turned down. Tosses this up on off and it turns back in on landing. Roach looks to defend but gets rapped on the pads. The ball is going down the leg side though.
Googly on off, Roach does well to prod forward and keep it out.
Tossed up ball on off, driven to wide long off for another run.
Full toss on his legs, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav comes back into the attack.
Shortish and on off, Holder pulls but finds mid on.
Fuller and on off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
Slower one outside off, Roach guides it down to third man for a run.
Good length ball on off, Roach jumps and blocks.
A length delivery on off, Roach stays back and defends it off the inner half of his bat.

Not out! A length ball angling into the batsman, Holder is stuck inside the crease as he fails to flick. He is hit on the pads, they appeal as the ball rolls to point. Roach shows interest in a run but is sent back as the fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The ball deflects and now they cross. The umpire checks upstairs and Roach is found to be safely in.
Eventful delivery! The lbw appeal is turned down and now it's referred upstairs for a run out...
Fuller ball around off, Roach has defended it off his front foot.
The right-hander has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up on off, Roach has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Played to the point region by Kemar.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
7th ODI fifty up for the Windies captain. Holder taps this good length ball on off towards the point region and takes a run to get yet another ODI half century. Well played, Jason Holder.
Jadeja is back on.
Bouncer this time but wide of off. Roach sways away to let that one go behind to MSD.
Perfect yorker on the base of off stump, Roach does really well to bring his bat down in time and dig it out.
Fuller on off this, driven to Jadeja at point.
Shorter of a goof length around off, Roach does well to get behind the line of that delivery and blocks it out.
Attempted yorker but turns out to be a half volley on middle and off. Holder drives it to mid on and takes a quick single to move on to 49.
Full ball attacking the stumps, driven to point from within his crease.
Jasprit Bumrah is brought back into the attack.
Holder goes on the back foot and eases it to covers for a brisk single. Retains strike.
Flatter and on middle, Holder stays back and helps it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Moves to 47! Floated full ball outside off, Holder goes with the spin and drills his drive through covers.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Turning away, Roach outside edges his attempted cover drive past first slip for a couple of runs.
Loopy and on off, Holder strokes it off his front foot through mid off for one.
Roach has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Turning away from the batsman, Roach tries to push inside the line but misses.
Strides forward and drives it through mid off for a run.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Dhawan drops a dolly! Flatter and shorter ball outside off, Holder punches it in the air at covers where Dhawan maybe takes it too lightly and drops it.
Full and around off, driven off the front foot to covers. Straight to the fielder.
Quicker and fuller on off, driven off the front foot covers.
Full and on off, Roach is on the front foot to defend it but it turns away to beat the outside edge.
Flighted this one in the air and lands it full around off, Jason drives it to Dhawan at covers who misfields and parries it towards long off. A single.
Fires in a flat and quick delivery, 103 kph, Holder tries to work it away but misses and is hit on the pads.
Tossed up around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Flighted and full, pitching outside leg, Holder tries to slog but misses and is hit on the left leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kemar Roach is the new batsman in.

OUT! Stumped! Lighting quick work by MSD, as always. Jadeja tosses this on off and gets it to turn away. Paul, looking to defend it off the front foot, strides forward but is beaten by the away spin. Dhoni behind whips the bails off in a jiffy. They go upstairs for the stumping appeal and Paul is seen walking. India are already celebrating and the replays later confirm that Keemo was outside the crease. End is nigh for the Windies!
Appeal for a stumping! The square leg umpire refers it upstairs while Keemo Paul is walking. Dhoni is very sure. Still the umpire doesn't want to take any chance.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

SIX! It's Paul this time as he goes over the long on boundary again and does it successfully. A full ball this around off and Paul launches into it and sends it over the long on fence for a biggie. Going down with a fight are the Windies.
Tossed up again and Holder goes for the big hit again. This time though he does not time it that well and the ball falls short of Bumrah at long on. The batsmen cross over for a run.

SIX! BANG! Keeps it slow and gives it a bit more air, lands it on off. Holder goes for the big shot straight down the ground and connects well. The ball goes sailing over the head of the long on fielder for a maximum.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the back foot to covers.
Straighter ball on middle and off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats this up and gives it a bit more air tempting Holder into the big shot. Holder goes for the heave but ends up with an inside edge into the square leg region for a brace.
Fuller in length, Holder defends it off the front foot into mid-wicket.
Lands this googly on middle and leg. Holder goes back and punches this to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, played back to the bowler.
Paul has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Maiden!

A caught and bowled chance. Jadeja slows this one in the air and lands it full on middle. It stops a bit on Paul who tries to go at it with firm hands. Ends up chipping it back but it doesn't carry to the bowler.
Takes a big stride forward and defends it down.
Spinning away, from a shorter length, Paul moves back and pushes it to point.
This time Paul goes back and blocks it towards the bowler.
Full and on middle, defended back off the front foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A thick inside edge on this one as he looks to punch it through covers. Gets a single as the ball rolls in the vacant mid-wicket region.
Tossed up ball on off, driven to mid off for a run.
A bit shorter in length this, Paul pulls this through square leg to pick up a run.
SIX! Flighted ball on middle and leg, Paul picks it early and slog sweeps it through the leg side. This one has gone all the way over the ropes for a six. Good counter-attacking cricket this.
Quicker and flatter around off. Paul looks for the big heave over the mid-wicket region but is beaten as the ball lands into MSD's mitts.
Gives himself room and exposes all his stumps. Jadeja fires it in line with the stumps but Paul whacks it down to long off for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Similar ball this, punches to long on for a single.
A bit shorter of full length, punched to mid-wicket.
Well tossed up on off, Holder pushes it to covers.
Jaddu starts his new over with a flatter delivery on middle. Holder comes forward and blocks it out.
Tossed up around off, Paul lunges forward in a solid defense.
FOUR! Interesting way to get off the mark. Kneels down and whacks this slop sweep over mid-wicket for a boundary off his very first ball.

OUT! Edged and taken! Another googly from Kuldeep as he lands this a bit shorter than a full length around off. Nurse goes back to punch it through covers but gets an outside edge which flies high to the right of Rohit at first slip. Sharma throws his hands out to grab a wonderful catch as Windies lose their 8th wicket. Matter of time now.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted and full around off, spinning in. Nurse comes forward to block it out.
Tossed up ball around off, prods forward in defense.
Holder has driven that ball straight back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Holder gets a big stride forward to defend it.
Drives this through covers for yet another couple of runs to be added to the total.
Gives himself room and lofts this drive over the cover region for a brace.
SIX! Smack! A bit behind the full length around off. Holder heaves it straight over the bowler's head. The fielder at long on is interested initially but the ball sails over his head for a maximum.
Shorter in length around off, punches to long off for a run.
The Windies physio is out in the middle. Nurse is getting some treatment done. All looks good though as we resume play again.
Tossed up ball on off. Driven through the covers by the Windies skipper. Two runs added to the total.
Three leg byes. Googly, on the leg stump line, Nurse looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls through the first slip region and the batsmen pick up three leg byes.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lands this one outside the leg stump line, turning away from the batsman. Nurse works it 'round the corner to pick up a brace.
Gives it a bit more air and keeps it around off. Nurse comes forward in a solid defense.
FOUR! Super shot! Ashley goes down on one knee and sweeps this full ball on off strongly through the square leg region for a smashing boundary. He made good use of the bottom hand there.
Length ball again to end the over, defended off the back foot into the point region.
A bit shorter of a good length and wide of off, punched through cover-point to cross over to the other end.
Attacking the good length is Bumrah and keeps it around off. Nurse does well to get behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.
Length ball on middle and off, Holder plays it to the right of mid on and picks up a single.
A bit shorter of a good length this around off. The Windies captain gets back nicely and defends this off the back foot.
Full, fast and angling in around off. Driven nicely to mid off.
Flights it and keeps it full on off. The ball pitches and turns back in to rap Nurse on the front pad. He's struck outside the line though.
Ashley Nurse is the next batsman in.

OUT! He's out of here! Beautiful bowling and wonderful slip catching. Kuldeep floats this up around middle and off, it's a googly. The ball lands and spins away from Allen who is looking to drive it down the ground. The ball spins away taking the outside edge and Rohit at first slip takes a good catch diving to his right.
Flighted again on off, hit through covers for a brace this time.
Flighted and very full on off, driven gently through mid off for a run.
Flighted again on off, Holder goes for the drive but the ball lands and spins back in to get his inside edge fine into the leg side. The batsmen get a brace.
Kuldeep starts from over the wicket with a tossed up ball on off, driven to covers.
Kuldeep Yadav comes into the attack.
On a length around off, Jason punches it to covers where Kohli fumbles to concede a single.
Bumrah bangs it in short, Allen swivels and plays the pull. Mistimes it through the mid-wicket region to get off strike.
Shorter of a good length on off, punches to point.
Length ball around off, Allen defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Fabulous shot! A fuller length ball around off, Allen drives this superbly through covers for a brilliant boundary.
A bit shorter of a good length around off, played into the point region to get a single.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Flatter and fuller on off, Allen looks to defend but gets rapped on the pads. Going down the leg though.
Shorter again on off, goes back to punch it through covers for a run.
A bit wide of off this, cut to sweeper cover to get off strike.
Slower on middle and leg, pushes back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Hurled well outside off, Allen looks to cut but fails to connect.
Too full and quite straight, flicked through the vacant square leg area for one run.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, punched back in the bowler's direction.
Pushes this away towards the cover region and gets a single for it.
Length delivery on middle stump, clipped down towards fine leg. Easy single collected.
Length delivery on off stump, kept out from within the crease.
Beaten! Jadeja slows this up and it spins away from a full length. Allen comes forward to drive away from the body but it goes past the outside edge.
Hits it down to long on for one more.
Quick, flat and short around off, forced off the back foot down to long off for a single.
Darts it quite full on off stump, dug out to the man at cover.
Full and outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, on middle and leg, flicked with the wrists in front of mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good bowling this by the left-hand pacer as he lands this on a good length around off. Allen does well to block it out with a straight bat.
Drinks break. Also, Fabian Allen is the next batsman in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. The youngster is on fire! 3 for Khaleel and 6 for India. He dishes this full and around off, shaping away from Samuels. Marlon is lazy as he reaches out at the ball without moving his feet. The result - an outside edge which flies to captain Kohli at wide first slip where he takes a sharp catch. India are all over Windies like a rash.
Well driven through the cover-point region to pick up a single.
Fuller and straighter on off, driven to mid on.

How did that miss the off pole? Holder is lucky to still be there. Khaleel continues with a good length ball around off and gets it to nip back in slightly. Jason is looking to play at it tentatively but is beaten as the ball goes between his bat and pad.

Safe. Holder works it off the inner half towards square leg and sets off. The throw comes in at the striker's end and a direct hit is scored, as Samuels drags his bat in. It's taken upstairs and replays show Marlon is safe, again.
A run out appeal goes upstairs. Samuels the man in question.
Driven through mid on easily for a run.

Not out! Samuels is safe. Looped up around off, it turns away and beats the outside edge of Samuels' bat who comes forward to block. Dhoni whips the bails off and appeals thinking Marlon has dragged his back leg out. It's taken upstairs and replays show that the batsman is fine.
A stumping appeal against Marlon Samuels is referred upstairs.
Backs away to this tossed up ball on the stumps and drives it through the covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slower through the air, drifting in at first but then spinning away from a full length. Holder drives it off the outer half to backward point.
FOUR! Length ball around middle and leg, Samuels lofts this over the mid-wicket region from within his crease. The ball races across the fence there. Wonderful shot by Marlon to end the over.
Played through mid-wicket by Holder to pick up a single and get off the mark.
Holder is struck on the thigh pad as he misses his flick off this short of a length ball around off. Indian players appeal but not out given as it is a bit too high.
Captain Jason Holder comes out to bat next.

OUT! A beauty from Khaleel! He gets his second. Dishes this on a good length from over the wicket. Powell looks to play at it with no footwork. The ball hits the deck and nips in to find the gap between the bat and pad and crashes into the stumps. Windies lose half their side for just 47. In trouble are the tourists now, need a big partnership.
Loose shot but he survives. Khaleel lands this on a length around off and angles it away from Powell. The right-hander reaches at it with minimal footwork and gets beaten.
On a good length from over the wicket, lands this on the middle and off line, cramping the batsman for room. Powell taps this to mid-wicket.
Drives it towards mid on for a single.
Full and straight, played back down the track to the bowler.
Skidding off the deck, flatter one around off, driven towards mid on.

Dropped! Only technically, was a really difficult chance. Looped up outside off, Samuels drives it away from his body on the up. Kohli at short cover dives low to his left, gets his fingertips to it but can't get fully underneath it. Single taken.
Drifts it on the pads, goes back and works it down on the off side.
Full and outside off, driven straight to the man at cover.
Powerplay 2 signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the 40th over. Also, Ravindra Jadeja is brought into the attack.
Shorter in length around off, punched to the cover region.
Good ball this, on a length around off. The ball passes right through the gap between the bat and body of Powell as he looks to defend. He's safe though.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the new batsman.
Rovman Powell comes into the middle.

OUT! Gone! It's a length ball on off, slower in pace and shaping into Hetmyer's pads. The southpaw looks to defend towards the leg side but the ball beats his bat and hits his back leg. The Indians go up in a big appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The Windies decide to go upstairs. Replays roll in and show that the impact is on middle stump. Ball Tracking, however, says it is clipping middle stump. The southpaw has to make his way back. Another in-form batsman is back in the pavilion for Windies and they are in complete disarray!
Review taken against an LBW decision. The batsman in question is Shimron Hetmyer. Looks close, this.
A fuller ball on middle and off, Hetmyer looks to go over mid off but gets the outer half of the bat. The ball flies over the point region and the batsmen come back for a brace.

Edged but falls just short of MSD. Khaleel starts well with a good length ball around off. Shimron tries to push at it from within the crease, without much foot movement. He plays it a bit inside the line of that one resulting in a faint edge which falls just short of Dhoni before going into his mitts.
Khaleel Ahmed, the left-arm quick, comes into the attack.

FOUR! Fuller and angling into Marlon on middle and leg. He flicks it through mid-wicket with brilliant timing, the fielder at mid on tries to dive to his right to stop it but fails to do so. Boundary for the Windies.
Full ball on the stumps, driven crisply to mid on.
Length ball just wide of off, the southpaw guides it to third man to get a run.
Similar length but angling into his body, Marlon turns it away into the square leg region to get off strike.
Good comeback by Bhuvi as he dishes this out on a good length just on off, Samuels defends off the front foot.

FOUR! Shot! This will give a lot of confidence to Marlon Samuels. He stays in his crease and with lazy elegance just punches this short of a length ball on off through the cover region for a beautiful boundary.
FOUR! Fuller in length but on his pads, the southpaw elegantly flicks it through square leg for a lovely boundary.
Goes across the line to this length ball on middle and off, tries to smash it through the mid-wicket region but finds the fielder there.
FOUR! Whacked! The southpaw showing his class. The in-form Windies batsman gives himself a bit of room and smashes this length ball on off over the cover region for a smashing boundary.
On a good length around off, shaping away. Shimron plays it to cover-point.
A bit shorter of a good length this on middle and off and shaping into the right-hander, Samuels taps this into the mid-wicket region and takes a quick run.
Fuller in length and around off, Samuels drives this on the up but straight to mid off.
Similar ball this but Marlon this time opens the bat face and steers this to third man for a single.
Good consistency by the Indian pacer as he keeps this on a good length just around off, Samuels blocks it from within the crease.
Good bowling this by Bhuvi as he dishes this out on a good length again on off, Samuels turns this into the mid-wicket region.
Continues attacking the corridor of uncertainty. Marlon can just stay back and block it off the back foot.
Similar length but on the off stump line. Samuels stays back and defends it.
Keeps this on a good length just outside the off stump line, Samuels pulls his bat inside the line and lets the ball go behind.
Surprises Shimron with a bumper. The left-hander is hurried into the pull but still clears the infield over mid-wicket. Double taken and he's off the mark.
Darts it on a length on off stump, Hetmyer defends it on the off side from within the crease.
Shaping away from around off. On a length too. Hetmyer covers the line and shoulders arms.
Full and pitched outside off, Samuels pushes it a bit square through cover-point and gets to the other end.
Shimron Hetmyer walks into the middle next.

OUT! Another run out. Kieran Powell is out of here. Windies have their third wicket down and we're not even done with six overs. Samuels pushes this towards covers off the back foot. Powell takes off, but Kohli is quick to the ball. He dives, under arms it at the stumps at the bowler's end and hits the bull's eye. The run was never on, not sure what Kieran was doing there. Windies in some trouble here.
Back of a length well outside off, Samuels covers the line and lets it go.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Not that short to pull that one ans hence gets beaten as the ball skids below his bat to the keeper behind.
Marlon Samuels comes in next.

OUT! And India get the second one quickly. A huge moment in the match as the star of the last match for the Windies is out of here. Hope flicks this away towards mid-wicket and sets off for a tight single. Kuldeep Yadav stationed at mid on moves to his right, gets to the ball, quickly picks it up and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Hope seems to be struggling there as the umpire signals for the third umpire. Replays roll in and show Hope to be short of his ground. Big setback for the tourists.
Run out appeal has been taken upstairs. The batsman in question is Hope.
Length ball around off, pushes this off the back foot back to the bowler.

OUT! India draw first blood. Another failure for the opener. Kumar keeps this on a length around off, Hemraj looks to blast the drive on the up without much footwork. Ends up driving it uppishly to covers where Rayudu takes a sharp catch leaping up. Big breakthrough for India. The hosts need to make further inroads now.
Hemraj throws his hands at this length ball outside off, angling further away. The ball seams away further on landing beating the batsman's outside edge.
Powell goes after this full length ball outside off, gets beaten as there is no foot movement.

Not Out. The ball lands on a good length around middle and off shaping away from Powell. He tries to turn it into the leg side but the ball seems to have hit something on the way to the keeper. The Indians appeal but the umpire turns it down. Kohli has a chat with MSD and decides to go for the DRS after pointing the 'T'. Replays roll in and show there was no involvement of the bat. Not out given and India lose their review early again.
A review has been taken against a caught behind appeal. The umpire has given it not out. The batsman in question is Kieron Powell.
Shorter of a length around off, Powell pushes this into the point region off the back foot.
Similar delivery this, the southpaw taps this to the point region.
Keeps this short of a length again on middle and leg. Powell tries to play at it with a straight bat but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Beaten! lands this short of a good length around off angling away from the batsman. Powell looks to push at it tentatively but plays inside the line to get beaten.

SIX! Smashed! A length ball around middle and off from over the wicket, shaping away from the southpaw. Hemraj though whips this over the mid-wicket boundary for a handsome maximum. Bhuvneshwar Kumar is not being allowed to settle on a good line and length. Good start this by the Windies.
Wide! Strays down the leg side, Hemraj looks to pull but misses. Wide signaled.
FOUR! Width given and the batsman takes full toll. Short and wide outside off, Hemraj throws his hands at it and finds the gap through cover-point for a boundary.
Chandrapaul has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Swing and a miss. Bhuvi keeps it full angling across the southpaw. Hemraj flays at it from his crease but gets beaten as the ball nips away further on landing.
A bit straighter attacking the stumps. Hemraj tries to flick it but misses to get rapped on the pads.
Bhuvi continues with a full length ball around off. Hemraj creams the drive straight to cover-point where Rayudu fumbles but does not concede a run.
Angling away, on middle stump. Powell gets a safe leading edge a bit square towards cover-point.
Bit fullish and going away with the natural angle, outside off. Powell comes forward to drive away from the body but gets beaten.
Stifled lbw shout, but seems it's pitched outside leg. Length delivery angling across, Powell rocks back to pull it away. It stays a touch low and catches the batsman on the back pad.
Fraction straight in line, worked down in front of square leg for a single.
Seaming away from around off, Hemraj hangs inside the crease and pushes it down towards mid off.
Back of a length on middle stump, Hemraj stays behind the line and defends it out.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.

FOUR! Whipped for a wonderful boundary! Lovely shot! Bhuvi lands this short of a good length on leg, the southpaw nonchalantly whip-pulls this off the back foot over the deep square leg fence for the first boundary of the innings. The Windies are off and running.
A length ball outside off, reaches at it away from the body, gets an outside edge to third man for a single.
Wide! Strays this wide down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
Goes on the back foot to this shorter delivery on off, punches it through cover-point for a brace.

Leading edge but safe. Hemraj tries to work this length ball into the leg side but is a bit early into the shot. The ball takes a leading edge and lobs into the off side and falls short of the cover fielder.
Similar length but on middle and off this time. Hemraj pushes it back to the bowler off the back foot.
Starts with a short of a good length ball around off, Hemraj punches this to covers where captain Kohli makes a diving stop.

We are all set to get the second innings underway as the umpires and the Indian players are seen making their way out to the middle. The Windies opening pair of Kieran Powell and Hemraj Chandrapaul also stride out to the center with the latter taking strike. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start proceedings for the home side.
